subject: reasoning
question: Statements: Some roads are highways. All highways are streets. Conclusions: I. All roads are streets. II. Some streets are highways.

options.text: If neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6d6dccf7ab517ee553ace1d2784b96807825eca9255bb34c3a0983a662c70ee.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All roads are streets → False (Only some roads are highways and highways are streets, but all roads are not necessarily streets).

II. Some streets are highways → True (Since all highways are streets, therefore some streets are highways).

Hence, **Only Conclusion II follows**.
